'''Culroon III''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Culroon system/Legends|Culroon system]], located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].

==Description==
Culroon III was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Promotion" /> in the [[Culroon system/Legends|Culroon system]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="TEA-OC" /> It contained a [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]].<ref name="Fact File 31">{{FactFile|31|VEE 1-2|General Maximilian Veers}}</ref>

==History==
Due to Culroon III long history of extreme violence and constant civil war, it largely ignored by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Due to their constant warring, the Culroon natives never developed [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travel, but would trade for technological devices.

As the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] expanded, it decided to construct a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on Culroon III, where [[General/Legends|General]] [[Irrv]] agreed to stage a ceremonial surrender of the [[Culroon]] [[Species/Legends|species]] by their leader, [[Kloff]]. When it turned out to be an [[Insurrection on Culroon III|insurrection]] by the Culroon, the Imperial staff was rescued by an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] commanded by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]].

==Inhabitants==
Culroon III was inhabited by the native Culroon,<ref name="Promotion" /> a tribal warlike species<ref name="Fact File 31" /> whose violence prevented them from developing [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travel.<ref name="Promotion" />

==Locations==
An Imperial garrison was established on Culroon III by the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Promotion" />

==Behind the scenes==
Culroon III first appeared in the short story "[[The Promotion of Lieutenant Veers]]," published in [[1987]] in [[West End Games]]'s ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'' written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and [[Curtis Smith]].<ref name="Promotion" /> The planet was first visually depicted in the [[1998]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]. The game places Culroon III in the [[Kanchen sector/Legends|Kanchen sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]],<ref name="Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> however, other sources place the Kanchen Sector in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. ''[[Star Wars: Rebellion: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' misspells the planet as "'''Culoon III'''."<ref name="Rebellion Prima">[[Star Wars: Rebellion: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Rebellion'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> The stat card for [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] in the [[Star Wars Miniatures]] game ([[Star Wars: Dark Times|Dark Times]]: 22/40) misspells the planet "Culrron III".
